name: Muikaichi (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Muikaichi town emblem in yellow: a stylised device of a ring open at the top with a disc and a base.
history: Flag of the former town of Muikaichi in Shimane Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-10-01.

features.role: Muikaichi town emblem — a stylised device of a ring open at the top with a disc and a base
